descriptionChirho: The proper name Jachin/Yakhin (יָכִין), meaning 'he will establish.' Borne by multiple individuals and used as the name of a temple pillar: (1) a son of Simeon (Gen 46:10, Exod 6:15, Num 26:12), (2) the name of the right-hand bronze pillar erected at Solomon's temple (1 Kgs 7:21, 2 Chr 3:17), (3) a priestly head in the time of David (1 Chr 9:10, 24:17), and (4) a post-exilic priest (Neh 11:10). All multilingual glosses converge on a single proper-noun rendering: Arabic ياكين, German Jachin, Hindi याकीन/याखीन, Korean 야킨/야긴, Spanish Jaquin. The four auto-clusters reflect only prefixed prepositions (ל to/for, ו and), which are inflectional variants, not different senses.
